title: Kolosal AutoML
description: A single-crate Rust AutoML framework covering data prep, model search, trust/quality tooling, and serving in one binary.

preprocessing-scaling.title: Preprocessing & Scaling
preprocessing-scaling.description: Standard/MinMax/Robust scalers, OneHot/Label/Target/Hash encoders, and Log/Power/Box-Cox/Yeo-Johnson transformers.

missing-value-imputation.title: Missing Value Imputation
missing-value-imputation.description: Mean/median/mode/forward-fill plus MICE, KNN, and iterative imputers fill gaps before training.

feature-engineering.title: Feature Engineering
feature-engineering.description: Generates polynomial features, pairwise interactions, and TF-IDF vectors to expand the feature space automatically.

synthetic-data-balancing.title: Synthetic Data Balancing
synthetic-data-balancing.description: SMOTE, ADASYN, and random oversampling correct class imbalance, with a recently re-optimized neighbor search.

time-series-utilities.title: Time Series Utilities
time-series-utilities.description: Time-series-specific feature extraction, differencing, and time-aware cross-validation splitting.

multi-model-training-engine.title: Multi-Model Training Engine
multi-model-training-engine.description: Trains and cross-validates 17+ algorithms (linear/logistic regression, decision trees, random forest, SVM, etc.) behind one unified interface.

hyperoptx-hyperparameter-search.title: HyperOptX Hyperparameter Search
hyperoptx-hyperparameter-search.description: Bayesian (Gaussian-process/TPE), random, and grid samplers with median/percentile/Hyperband pruners.

autopipeline-construction.title: AutoPipeline Construction
autopipeline-construction.description: Auto-detects column/data types and assembles a preprocessing-to-training pipeline without manual configuration.

ensemble-methods.title: Ensemble Methods
ensemble-methods.description: Voting and stacking ensembles combine multiple trained models into one predictor.

neural-architecture-search.title: Neural Architecture Search
neural-architecture-search.description: DARTS-style differentiable search plus TabNet/FT-Transformer architectures, hand-implemented over ndarray with no autodiff crate.

explainability.title: Explainability
explainability.description: Permutation importance, partial dependence (1D/2D/ICE), and a kernel-SHAP-like local explainer for per-prediction attributions.

probability-calibration.title: Probability Calibration
probability-calibration.description: Platt scaling, isotonic regression, temperature scaling, and beta calibration, with ECE/MCE/Brier-score reporting.

drift-detection.title: Drift Detection
drift-detection.description: KS-test/PSI/Jensen-Shannon distributional checks plus online detectors (DDM, ADWIN, Page-Hinkley, EDDM).

anomaly-detection.title: Anomaly Detection
anomaly-detection.description: Isolation Forest and Local Outlier Factor detect outliers, both backed by a KD-tree neighbor search.

pipeline-quality-gates.title: Pipeline Quality Gates
pipeline-quality-gates.description: A four-gate quality pipeline (pre-training, training, hyperopt convergence, post-training calibration/OOD) backed by a dedicated integration test suite.

web-dashboard-cli.title: Web Dashboard & CLI
web-dashboard-cli.description: An Axum-served htmx+Alpine dashboard (upload, configure, train, monitor) and a CLI (train/predict/preprocess/benchmark/serve) share one binary.

inference-model-export.title: Inference & Model Export
inference-model-export.description: A batching/caching inference engine plus ONNX/PMML export, a model registry, and versioning.

security-access-control.title: Security & Access Control
security-access-control.description: API key/JWT auth, sliding-window rate limiting, RBAC roles, and input-validation middleware.

iso-compliance-suite.title: ISO Compliance Suite
iso-compliance-suite.description: Fairness/bias scanning, PII detection, data-lineage/provenance tracking, and compliance reporting toward ISO 42001/27701/TR 24027.
